topology_note: R1 is the DHCP server for VLAN 10 (10.10.10.0/24). A DNS server runs at 10.10.10.5 on Fa0/20 of SW1. DHCP pushes DNS settings to clients.
expected_fault: DHCP pool distributes the wrong DNS server address — 10.10.10.50 (non-existent) instead of 10.10.10.5 (the actual DNS server). Clients send DNS queries to a host that does not exist.
source_evidence:
R1# show running-config | section dhcp
ip dhcp pool VLAN10-POOL
 network 10.10.10.0 255.255.255.0
 default-router 10.10.10.1
 dns-server 10.10.10.50

C:\> ipconfig /all
Ethernet adapter Ethernet0:
   IPv4 Address. . . . . . . . . : 10.10.10.11
   Subnet Mask . . . . . . . . . : 255.255.255.0
   Default Gateway . . . . . . . : 10.10.10.1
   DNS Servers . . . . . . . . . : 10.10.10.50

C:\> ping 10.10.10.5
Reply from 10.10.10.5: bytes=32 time<1ms TTL=128
Reply from 10.10.10.5: bytes=32 time<1ms TTL=128
